items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: I never did know his name. Nothing but Jazz Baby.

ctx.x: Yeah, it was a ballroom. And upstairs, jumping giant upstairs. I see. I see. I just sent the best here, an East-Flexed lioness. My brother gave it to me and I couldn't learn, I gave it to Sidney. You know, he used to take an old job and play. You could play any kind of lioness. My brother used to buy him a lioness too, you know. He learned, but he learned, but he didn't learn good, you know. He never was famous, my brother, you know. Which brother? Which one of his brothers? My, he's about two. The one older than…
Jazz Baby. I never did know his name. Nothing but Jazz Baby.
